common: Detailed hand-painted 2D educational illustration; no photos, labels or frame; true transparent alpha PNG.

briefs.opener: Landscape 3:2 composition. Indian woman science teacher in a soft ochre sari stands behind a wooden classroom worktable with two eleven-year-old Indian students, girl and boy in light blue school uniforms, all visibly illustrated. They thoughtfully examine everyday materials: a small red terracotta pot, a closed notebook, wooden block, shiny steel tumbler, clear plastic water bottle and folded cotton cloth. Girl holds a notebook, boy compares tumbler with wooden block; teacher gestures toward items. Natural anatomically correct hands. Table and group form one coherent foreground vignette on transparent background. No other room or furniture.
briefs.balls: Very wide 3:1 composition, three clearly separated approximately equal-size spheres side by side on one baseline: left a fuzzy lime green tennis ball with curved white seam; centre a red leather cricket ball with its visible stitched seam; right a plain blue soft foam hand-exercise ball. Their different surface textures should be clear. No hands or motion arrows. No text. Keep equal gaps. All on alpha transparency.
briefs.panes: Wide 3:1 three-part scientific comparison, all on genuinely transparent background. Three matching simple tabletop upright rectangular samples in very slim unobtrusive wooden stands. Left clear glass, showing a red toy car behind it with sharp recognisable details. Middle frosted translucent glass with an identical red toy car behind it, only an indistinct diffuse red shape visible through the panel (no recognisable sharp car outline). Right an opaque unpainted wooden board of identical size completely blocks the third toy; no toy visible through or around it. Front view, equal sizes, separated cleanly. Material edges realistic painted, no text. Samples themselves are not decorative frames.
briefs.mixing: Wide 3:1 science activity SETUP only before mixing. Exactly five identical clear tumblers in one straight row, each two-thirds filled with clear water, nothing added. In front of each is a small shallow dish, respectively white sugar crystals, fine white salt, chalk powder, tan sand, pale brown sawdust. One small separate clean spoon on far right. All distinct, nonoverlapping, equal gaps, no outcome shown, no floating or settled material in water, no letters. Accurate containers with light painted highlights on transparent background.
briefs.mass: Landscape 3:2 isolated classroom apparatus. Compact silver digital kitchen balance with a flat circular weighing pan and an empty dark blank display (no digits). A plain white paper cup half filled with clear water rests centrally on the pan; two matching white paper cups stand separately alongside, one half filled with sand and one half filled with small pebbles. Cups have the same physical dimensions and fill level. Accurate scientific illustrative cutout, no scale reading, no text. White paper cups opaque; view from enough above to see contents.
briefs.pottery: Landscape 3:2 still-life, two red terracotta clay vessels: one simple rounded storage jar with narrow neck and dark geometric painted bands, and a small shallow earthenware bowl beside it. Detailed hand-painted porous clay texture. Historical craft illustration, not a reproduction of a specific archaeological object. No museum base or text. All edges visible genuine alpha.
briefs.hardness: Wide 3:1 four distinct small material samples lined up: a soft yellow porous sponge, a pink rubber eraser, a light brown rectangular wooden block, and a shiny stainless steel spoon. Same baseline and generous spacing, easy to identify, no text or hands. Clearly painted 2D real materials with texture, not icons. Transparent background.
briefs.reuse: Landscape 3:2 a handmade desktop pencil organiser made from three clean cardboard tubes of different heights fixed onto a sturdy recycled cardboard base, covered with neat colourful paper scraps. A few pencils and a ruler inside. A closed notebook alongside. No scissors, trash or unsafe sharp cut metal. Painted textures of paper and card obvious. Isolated transparent PNG no text.
